findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "find_source" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Source router. Given a topic or question about bitcoin or digital-asset market structure (ETF holdings or custodians, stablecoin supply or attestations, tokeniz…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_source, search_transcripts · Private data: get_custody_platform, list_custody_incidents, get_coldcard_incident_status, get_hardware_wallet_scores, find_source · Public sink: get_stablecoin_supply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_source, search_transcripts · Private data: get_custody_platform, list_custody_incidents, get_coldcard_incident_status, get_hardware_wallet_scores, find_source · Public sink: get_stablecoin_supply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
